+import heapq

+def _route(data, exact, minimum_duration):
+    required = data.get("required", [])
+    bit = {node: 1 << i for i, node in enumerate(required)}
+    full = (1 << len(required)) - 1
+    source, target = data["source"], data["target"]
+    initial_mask = bit.get(source, 0)
+    start = data["start"]
+    graph = [[] for _ in range(data["n"])]
+    for edge in data["edges"]:
+        graph[edge["u"]].append(edge)
+
+    # A state includes every property affecting future feasibility.
+    initial = (source, initial_mask, 0)
+    best = {initial: start}
+    queue = [(start, source, initial_mask, 0)]
+    while queue:
+        time, node, mask, used = heapq.heappop(queue)
+        state = (node, mask, used)
+        if best.get(state) != time:
+            continue
+        if (node == target and mask == full and
+                (used == data["coupons"] if exact else True)):
+            return {"arrival": time}
+        for edge in graph[node]:
+            depart = max(time, edge["open"])
+            if depart >= edge["close"]:
+                continue
+            options = [(depart + edge["duration"], used)]
+            if used < data["coupons"]:
+                duration = max(minimum_duration,
+                               edge["duration"] - edge.get("discount", 0))
+                options.append((depart + duration, used + 1))
+            for arrival, next_used in options:
+                if arrival > data["deadline"]:
+                    continue
+                next_node = edge["v"]
+                next_mask = mask | bit.get(next_node, 0)
+                next_state = (next_node, next_mask, next_used)
+                if arrival < best.get(next_state, float("inf")):
+                    best[next_state] = arrival
+                    heapq.heappush(queue, (arrival, next_node, next_mask, next_used))
+    return {"arrival": None}
+
